processing_validity.actor_interface: Actor receives phase-scoped numeric inputs only; no images or experiences. Processor uses RGB and public geometry. Outputs are XYZ/rotation signs, OPEN/CLOSE/KEEP, CONTINUE/ADVANCE/STOP.
processing_validity.measurement_checks: Require both registration correlations >=0.70, >=1000 samples/view, wrist-Z discrepancy <=1mm, pose rank=6 and RMS<=4px. Current observations pass. These are consistency checks, not calibrated error bounds.
processing_validity.pose_model: Fit unconstrained six-DOF pose. The initial horizontal plane supplies metric registration only.
processing_validity.ambiguity: Run deterministic unperturbed restarts separately. Retain admissible competing solutions and union their measurement intervals. Reject incompatible grasp/sweep alternatives or an infeasible union. The ten accepted perturbed refits do not establish uniqueness.
processing_validity.sensitivity: Propagate the specified 2px perturbations, initial/current allowances, mint contour vertices and blade-tip source interval. Preserve correlations within each hypothesis. The 5.01mm tested gain range is measurement sensitivity; no 3mm rejection applies across perturbed fits.
processing_validity.conditional_gate: Require all enumerated hypotheses to permit the proposed grasp and bounded sweep, and a nonempty lift range satisfying lower gain>=100mm and upper gain<=130mm. Interval width>30mm is infeasible. Acceptance remains conditional on the represented geometry, sampled uncertainty and tested restarts.
processing_validity.current: Zero-lift gain interval=[-8.74,8.27]mm. Its 17.01mm width permits a completion window if uncertainty remains comparable. Under pure translation, 115mm would yield [106.26,123.27]mm; this illustration cannot replace fresh visual measurements. Unperturbed-mode and sweep checks remain pending.

candidate_height.construction: 7.5mm distal extent plus 0.5mm nominal table gap. Mint top=table+4.5mm; neck width=30.9mm.
candidate_height.link6_target: p_LINK6=p_pad-R*[150.07,0,0]mm. With local +X downward, LINK6 Z=table+158.07mm.
candidate_height.allowed_source_uncertainty: Use the supplied ±2mm table allowance: distal clearance=[-1.5,2.5]mm. Permit represented table penetration up to 2mm during final descent/closure. Include orientation and positioning allowances in that bound; reject if exceeded. The 0.665mm discrepancy is not an additional certified error bound.
candidate_height.other_sources: Blade-tip source is its original visible ray intersecting table+[-2,5]mm. Propagate the conditional center halfwidths [3.0,4.09,3.68]mm through grasp/sweep and gain calculations; do not substitute them for table uncertainty. Require nominal neck overlap, without claiming guaranteed bilateral contact.

deterministic_processing.budget: Each action uses 1..5 steps at 0.04s/step. Listed stage action caps sum to 390 including recovery; enforce 120/stage and 500 overall.
deterministic_processing.compiler: Use up to 5 steps/action; translation caps: alignment 3mm, descent 1mm, lift/return 2mm; rotation cap 0.03rad/action. Also enforce native LINK6 target increments<=50mm and <=0.35rad. Validate actor signs against phase errors; incompatible signs cause STOP, never sign reversal.
deterministic_processing.sweeps: Before each action, check swept public meshes against represented RGB geometry and phase interaction allowances. Unknown scene geometry remains outside this conditional check.
deterministic_processing.visual_intervals: Recompute from fresh observations. Missing fits, infeasible intervals, budget exhaustion or unsafe sweeps stop advancement.

physical_stages.current_pass: Pending target construction and sweep checks.
physical_stages.pass: At the validated above-neck waypoint; target errors<=1mm and <=0.03rad.
Pad reaches table+8mm within 1mm; interaction bound remains satisfied.
Decrement target 1mm per chunk toward 28.9mm, approximately 60 chunks; latch target. Closure alone proves no attachment.
KEEP; actual visual gain lower bound>0. Three fresh observations admit a common object-to-gripper transform within their sampled intervals.
KEEP; visual lower gain>=100mm, upper gain<=130mm, cumulative gripper rise<=130mm.
KEEP stationary for >=1s; every sampled gain interval remains within [100,130]mm and admits stable attachment. Neither commands nor native outcome establish completion.

one_recovery.trigger: Failed attachment verification before main lift.
one_recovery.procedure: KEEP and reverse the validated test-rise path. OPEN only after visual placement overlaps the original table-rest interval; retreat along the checked approach and STOP unsuccessful. If supported placement cannot be established, STOP while keeping the latch.

stage_objectives.approach_open: Align the open gripper above the visible solid mint neck; orient the public finger tool downward.
stage_objectives.engage_material: Descend to the calculated shallow candidate acquisition height; this is not proven contact.
stage_objectives.close: Close slowly around the neck; a measured stall or target aperture creates only a candidate grasp.
stage_objectives.capture_lift_test: Maintain the latched aperture and actively lift15mm; test fresh visible target following.
stage_objectives.raise_10cm: Keep the latched aperture and lift until the whole represented material gain interval lies within100..130mm.
stage_objectives.hold_verify: Hold still with the latched aperture for at least1second and verify stable visual height and attachment.
stage_objectives.complete: Maintain the latched grasp with zero motion.

compiler_notes: Stage labels map approach_open->align, engage_material->descend, capture_lift_test->verify_attachment, raise_10cm->raise, hold_verify->hold.
Use the user-authorized120-action per-stage ceiling and500 overall. A3mm alignment increment cannot cover the initial measured displacement in the proposed50actions.
A stalled measured aperture across two actions may advance to the active test, as explicitly allowed in the preceding Pro execution plan; no capture is inferred.
Sampled uncertainty intervals and robot/table sweeps are conditional, not complete scene collision or contact certificates.
